summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Direxion Daily Dow Jones Internet Bull 3X ETF (WEBL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the DJ Internet Composite index. The fund provides 3x leveraged daily exposure to a market-cap-weighted index of the largest and most liquid U.S. Internet companies. WEBL was launched on Nov 7, 2019 and is issued by Direxion.

holdings.infoBox: WEBL is an equity ETF with a total of 47 individual holdings. The top holdings are DJINET SWAP ASSET LEG stock at 236.07%, DREYFUS GOVT CASH MAN INS at 25.13%, GOLDMAN FINL SQ TRSRY INST 506 at 16.19%, Meta Platforms at 7.06%, and Alphabet at 6.67%.
